harnessDisclosures.cellSelectionSetup: Raw mouse/click events do not carry modifier keys. Cell-selection setup used a DISCLOSED synthetic MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,shiftKey:true,clientX,clientY}) dispatched on the target cell (the app listens to editor mousedown with e.shiftKey); the merge/split operations themselves were real toolbar clicks.
harnessDisclosures.imageClicks: Image selection used real mouse move/down/up at coordinates measured from getBoundingClientRect.
harnessDisclosures.drag: Free-image drag used real mouse move/down/move/up.

findings.title: Image toolbar Align left / Align center buttons are rendered underneath the document-tabs sidebar at default desktop viewport (<= ~1345px), so clicks land on tab-tree UI
repro: Viewport 1280x720 (default), zoom 100%, rich mode, Print Layout.
Insert any image (Insert > Pictures) at/near top of the page; click it to show the floating image toolbar.
Observe toolbar style left:-65px inside #canvasWrap (canvasWrap x=512 w=768; toolbar offsetWidth=825).
elementFromPoint at first two button centers returns BUTTON#document-tab-tab-main / button.document-tab-row-menu (sidebar paints above the toolbar's left spill).

agent-browser click on 'Align left' -> 'covered by <button#document-tab-tab-main>'; data-align stays 'center'. Same for 'Align center' (covered by document-tab-row-menu). 'Align right' (x>520) succeeds -> data-align='right'.
findings.expected: All image-toolbar buttons clickable; toolbar clamped inside the canvas area.
findings.observed: First two toolbar buttons (Align left, Align center) are covered by the document-tabs sidebar; clicks are misdirected to tab UI.
controls: Same toolbar, same y: 'Align right' button click works (x past sidebar edge).
Viewport 1600x900: canvasWrap w=1088 > toolbar 825+16 -> toolbar left:131.5px, first button clickable (elementFromPoint = the button itself).
Geometry: tabs sidebar rect [272..512] vertically 190..542; toolbar at viewport x=447..1272.
findings.sourceMechanism: app-js.txt line ~962 (Images.sync toolbar positioning): tl=clamp(tl,8,canvasWrap.clientWidth-tw-8). With tw(825) > canvasWrap.clientWidth(768)-16 the max bound is negative and clamp returns it -> imgToolbar.style.left='-65px' -> toolbar slides left out of #canvasWrap under the document-tabs sidebar which paints above it. Related to B211 family (toolbar placement) but different trigger/mechanism (desktop clamp inversion, sidebar overlap), not the mobile viewport case.
findings.impact: Align left/center unreachable from the toolbar on common laptop widths; misdirected clicks hit the tab tree (possible unintended tab context-menu activation). Fix: clamp max must respect min (Math.max(min, ...)) or wrap the toolbar.

findings.title: Rediscovered B210: free-image selection outline (figure.img-fig.selected outline solid 2px) stays at the original anchor while the image renders at its offset position (also after arrow-key nudge at 100% zoom)
findings.evidence: After drag: img rect (626,550) vs figure rect (776,286); figure carries class 'selected' + computed outline 'solid 2px'. After ArrowRight/ArrowDown nudge (data-image-x -150->-149, y 264->265) the figure outline still sits at the anchor.

findings.title: Rediscovered B283: sorting table rows reverses aggregate formula ranges (=SUM(B2:B3) -> =SUM(B3:B2) -> '#REF!'); also reproduced with a 3-body-row sort (rotation), same reversed-range outcome
findings.evidence: 3-row case: rows B/C/A with =SUM(B2:B4)=40 -> after sort by Name: formula '=SUM(B3:B2)' displayed '#REF!'. Undo of sort restores range and value exactly. No silent-wrong-value variant found: the remap is per-moved-cell, so only relative-order reversal breaks (always loud #REF!).

findings.title: Free image placement round-trip changes stored width 100% -> 50% (enter) and keeps 50% on exit
findings.evidence: Source (app-js.txt, free-placement toggle): entering free mode sets width to 50% when figure width >= 95% of editor width (explicit code path); exit deletes placement attrs without touching width. Width remains user-adjustable; not a data-integrity violation. Observed earlier exit-to-natural(10px) was traced to my own stray click on the toolbar's Natural size button, not app behavior.

findings.title: '=SUM(ABOVE)' yields '#FORMULA!'
findings.evidence: Parser supports explicit A1-style refs/ranges only; the Table formula dialog explicitly says 'Use cell references, + - x /, SUM, AVERAGE, ...'. Word's ABOVE/LEFT keywords are a parity gap, not a contract violation.
